avis.titre: Super fun & calming masks!Super fun & calming masks!
avis.texte: UPDATE: 11.30.17 I have ordered these 2 X since I last wrote the review - I honestly use them as part of my self-care and "happy" place for myself - I'm currently a grad (older than most) student and they often talk about taking better care of onself. I literlaly put one of these on when I'm studying or writing a paper (at home of course ha ha) and they SO help with making me feel relaxed. Granted, I cannot tell the difference between any of them (ha, they all feel good) but I find these so relaxing and my skin looks more pale (not sure if you like that but I do) after I use it but in a very glowing and healthy way - not as in a I need a blood transfusion! Wonderful little masks, I will also probably send some out as cute little Xmas gifts to my friends during the holidays! I adore these masks! I got 16 of them for like $8 via Amazon Prime & have been using one every day! I posted pics of me wearing it n a few days after. I'm 48 and while the wrinkles around my eyes are still there, my skin has a real glow. I don't wear foundation, just cream and have been using the Riversol skin care line along with these. Interesting to note, I splurged and paid over$100 for the famous Hanacure facials because a friend highly recommended. I'm actually disappointed in the little to no results from that expensive facial (4 facials for $119!!). I won't be re-ordering that again but I will re-order these! Also? I don't see a huge difference in any of these facials. They're all really soothing b

avis.titre: Amazing value, generous amounts of product, good for all types, good quality.
avis.texte: Purchased these a few years ago for my sister, who loved them, and then purchased them again last month but for myself! She has oily, acne prone skin and often wears face makeup. For reference, I have very dry, sensitive, 25 year old skin with the occasional tiny or big painful zit(s). I also have redness in my cheeks (closer to my nose), dry forehead+cheeks that flake when foundation is applied even after exfoliating. I do not use face products other than Japanese red ginseng facial cleanser and the occasional dab of Cerave basic dry skin moisturizer. I'm not big on skin care, but I'd like to get into it. For months, I have been seeing sheet masks in stores, but kept passing them up. I did the math, and these come out to <60 cents each, while the ones in the stores start at about two dollars, even the ones at the big blue supermarket. So I kept passing them up with these in mind, but kept putting off buying them because I didn't want to spend 10 bucks. I also have issues with instant gratification, so I didn't want to order them. I'm glad I did. So far I have used a few and the Aloe one is my favorite. Made my skin so soft and moist. I have trouble feeling moisture in my skin, and this mask helped. I really did not like the "Herb" one. I think it's lavender? I can't remember what the ingredients said, but there is a photo of lavender on the front, and usually I like herbal face treatments, especially since lavender is my favorite herb. This one kinda stung a little after put

avis.titre: Love the variety, skin looks hydrated and refreshed in minutesLove the variety, skin looks hydrated and refreshed in min
avis.texte: I’ve been ordering these for many years and I love them. First of all, the price is so much better than going to CVS, Walgreens, Target or even Walmart. But they come in so many different types/scents and they actually all smell different, so it’s not just different packaging with the same product. Compared to other brands the sheets are really enriched with fluid, they don’t dry out after being on the skin in just minutes. I’m no beauty or medical expert so I can’t say much about the ingredients. Will they give a 40YO the skin of at 20YO in 15 minutes? No. But will they give a mom a relaxed home spa feeling for a few minutes and make her skin look less tired? Yes, definitely! I don’t know what’s in there, but I do see how my skin looks fresher and more hydrated. They seem to have good ingredients, because I’m allergic and hypersensitive to many ingredients and it will show in my face immediately - but these have never caused any rash, redness or blemishes for me. And my skin type is usually a nightmare to take care of.

avis.titre: DERMAL Masks: A Korean Skincare Treat!
avis.texte: I am absolutely loving DERMAL's facial masks! These Korean masks are such a treat for my skin. Each mask is packed with serum, leaving my face feeling incredibly hydrated and refreshed. I've noticed a significant improvement in my skin's overall texture and brightness since I started using them. I am not sure if the different flavors really do anything significant, but it's fun to have options! What I appreciate most is the quality for the price. These masks are super affordable and don't tear apart, making it easy to incorporate them into my regular skincare routine. They adhere well to the skin, so I can relax or move around without worrying about them slipping off, and they don't smell like chemicals. If you're looking for an easy and effective way to boost your skin's hydration and radiance, I highly recommend giving DERMAL masks a try!

I take great pride in my skin care. I have a very extensive routine I do twice a day (to put into perspective, I started using night cream at 19) And the last few years I’ve been a fan of face masks but after doing avid research about ingredients in face care, I found myself throwing a lot of my go-tos in the trash. I was in a pinch (time wise and financially) and decided to come to amazon to fix hankering for a facelift. I found these beauts and started reading the reviews. I got about 50+ reviews in and was just completely shocked by the level of detail about these masks. Took a gander at the ingredients and said what the hell! I ordered. I’ve now used 5 of the 16pack with several days between each use, and I’ll be damned. These masks are outstanding. We are currently on Quarantine so I have a lot of time to be home, however, with that being said, I have noticed a huge difference in my skin from these masks. The bouts of acne I get from working out has Diminished, any skin discoloring has faded, fine lines have blended out, my skin is bouncy, firmer, glowing, and moisturized. Before using these masks I thought that my skin was already at its peak, clearly there was improvements to be made. I’ve had several compliments from my friends and family on FaceTime about how “refreshed and young” I look (I’m a mother of one very active little boy but also work 50+ hours a week). I honestly feel this is the best my skin has ever looked. The price couldn’t be better for the product. I

avis.titre: These masks are humble and doing the real things
avis.texte: I’ve been using sheetmasks for couple years and still a on going journey✨ I’m pretty confident about what good sheet masks should be like. I got this Dermal bundle on Amazon, since the prices are too friendly and I thought I would give them a try. The first impression is that they don’t look cheap at all with the thick and glossy plastic packaging. I’ve used the cucumber and herb one so far, and I find them have very pure scent just like being sourced directly from the natural ingredients. Both of them are very hydrating and well-absorbed, leaving skin soft and non-greasy. And these two are cooling and soothing, especially for the herb one it really calm my redness and pimples. The sheet can also cover your eyes lids so that you can enjoy them laying on bed with eyes closed like a spa session😌 I will update here when I used couple more different ones, and I’m honestly already very confident about them. These masks are just outstanding with the values you get at this low price (about 0.65/pc) even compared with many other ones that are more expensive, tho I’m not yet sure if they can do more on targeting specific needs like brightening or firming etc. In general I highly recommend these little genuine sheet masks!!! (My ig @itsmeyuzi_ for more reviews about sheet masks and beauty tips at all range🧖🏻‍♀️💖)

avis.titre: Great quality product but not good with delivery
avis.texte: I do love these face masks and I feel like they are a good price, however the reason they don't get five stars is because every time I get them delivered there is some weird slimy sticky substance on half of the outside of the face masks that I have to wipe them off with the Clorox wipe, it's worth it because I like the masks, but I would also not like to have to clean an unknown sticky substance off the outside of the packaging

avis.titre: Not the best out there, not terrible
avis.texte: I had been using the Trader Joe’s biocellulose face masks but they ran $4 a piece and I couldn’t justify that each day. I switched to these nightly because they seemed like decent quality for price and I was excited about the variety. They definitely hydrate your skin but certain ones irritated my sensitive skin, and I didn’t wake up with the same glow that I did with the TJs masks. I’ve switched to another brand at a similar price point that I like much better so I know it’s possible
The mask left my face feeling very soft and hydrated, I would highly recommend purchasing and I will be purchasing again.

avis.titre: منتج رائع بصراحه من بعد تجربه
avis.texte: هي منتج حلو بصراح يرطب الوجه وانا خلصتهم كلهم قبل اقيم المنتج اذا الوجه جاف يرطبه ويغذيه الحلو بعد انه ما يوصخ المكان بس منديل تحطيه وخلاص شفاف قبل تنامين استخدميه وشوفي النتيجه
Love this product, been purchasing it for the last 2 years and always happy with it. It gives a good moisturizing layer, skin is soft and supple after treatment. Good product and really good price

Wonderful product..can see a noticeable difference in your skin with the first use itself..works amazingly for dry skin..might work well for other skin types too..reduced my pore size too n made my skin feel softer n healthier

avis.titre: Good value for the price; Fast shipping.
avis.texte: These 16 collagen essence masks came in a resealable clear plastic bag. Each one was different! I was amazed at the variety of masks. The shipping was also fast (they came in two days!!) Here's what I got: Aloe, Royal jelly, Herb, Cucumber, Vitamin (has picture of orange), Green tea, Collagen, Hyaluronate, Syn-nake (has picture of snake), Snail, Platinum, Gold, Pearl, Charcoal, Q10 coenzyme, and White I tried the aloe mask first to help with my currently irritated skin. My skin is usually clear and nice, which people have complimented me on a bunch of times before. I only get acne when it's around that time of the month. Today, I had a few tiny pimples and the left side of my face was red and itchy from last night (probably because I slept on my face, which is a bad thing to do. From now on I'll keep sleeping on my back instead). I know that aloe helps with redness and sun burns, so that's why I chose this to try. I left the mask on for about 20-30 minutes and laid down on my bed. The mask is soothing and cool to the touch. It's also tingly in the beginning when I put it on. There wasn't any strong odor; it smells just like every other face mask I've used in the past from other brands. The mask easily fit my wide face. There's flaps on the masks to cover the eyelids if you want to. The mask was a nice shape - no problems with it at all. When I peeled the mask off, it still had a TON of essence, so I literally rubbed the mask on my neck, stomach, hands, arms, and legs because

avis.titre: Great For an Addition of Moisture to Your Skin
avis.texte: This is my second time purchasing these. This purchase is really about the perfect quantity, quality and price. I've used several brands of face masks, including the Body Shop, Nivea, Garnier, My Beauty Diary etc. This ranks near Body Shop at a slightly lower price. Each mask peels off from plastic and is easy to use, soothing and refreshing. Many of the masks have a nice scent, but they do lay on a little wet at the start, they seem saturated with the solution and do feel like you have condensed milk on you face. As it dries, it starts to feel more rejuvenating, but if the initial wetness grosses you out, then these probably aren't for you. I don't mind the excess moisture as much because I have a shower right after and I like to sit in front of a fan and have it dry faster. A fan really helps make this mask refreshing and soothing (I think there is a little methanol in this, it reminds me of a milder version of when you drink water while chewing gum). I use a dead sea mud mask as part of my weekly routine and need a decent moisturizing mask for after or my skin dries out too much, this suits that purpose very well. This is like a nice spa day, fun and refreshing, but don't expect it to do much for you skin except hydrate and perhaps smooth if the rest of your skin care regiment is good. I have found that excess use, more than twice a week can result in oily skin with combination skin types (like mine) and can even lead to a mild acne break out. Also, if you wear glasses, yo

First things first: I think one the masks or maybe a few of them exploded in the shipping process, because they arrived covered in stuff and wet (I tried to take a picture, but I'm not sure if it's visible) I assume it was a couple of them because no package was left unscathed and they were all soaked and sticky. I did not love that. Mess aside, these masks are wonderful! I'm a big skincare junkie and since I have sensitive and acne prone skin, I have to be extra careful about what I use. These are great! They work really well, no irritation, and immediately after using my skin felt so much smoother and softer than it typically does. I love the variety too, though I will say the fragrance doesn't seem to be strong- which is a plus for me, but might be disappointing if you're looking for a strong lavender effect or something. All in all, these are great! I wholeheartedly recommend! D

avis.titre: AMAZING, would buy again without hesitation.
avis.texte: I have been using this every day since I have incredibly dry skin. There are so many pros. - This leaves such a noticeable difference after I use it. My skin is visibly brighter, more even, and hydrated. I have used many hydrating masks in the past and this is one of the best. I use it then wait for the elixir to soak in a bit after I’ve removed the mask, then put on my other beauty care. - It’s not oily or heavy at all, so it can be used daily. - It’s easy to put on, I actually prefer this to the slightly fancier masks that have a plastic layer outside it that supposedly helps with application. - It stays. I eat with the mask on, and the part that I tuck under my chin also stays. It doesn’t fall like with many other masks. - It fits my face almost perfectly. My forehead is big and that’s the only part it doesn’t cover entirely. - The sides fold easy into itself and stays that way! This seems like a trivial thing but is so important because I don’t want to get the mask in my hair, especially after I’ve just washed it. - I can perfectly put the mask around my eyes. The eye holes are not cut out and removed entirely like with many other masks and I can fold the pieces so that they sit perfectly on my eye bags. Sooo important. - Price is very reasonable. I spend a lot of money on my beauty care and this goes to show that price isn’t everything. I use this mask then follow up with La Mer, and it really helps it soak in and stay. When I use La Mer by itself without this mask, my f
Great collagen boost after you’ve applied your other serums. Masks make the skin radiant and you can rub the excess serum on your hands, neck and upper chest for a soft glow.

I am thoroughly impressed with this 16 set of Korean face masks. Each mask in the set is different but equally of great quality. They all hydrate, brighten, and calm my skin, providing a comprehensive skincare experience. The inclusion of collagen in these masks helps reduce fine lines, firm the skin, and keep it healthy and moisturized. Self-care using these masks has become a regular weekend activity for my family, and we always feel so refreshed afterward. The masks deliver a spa-quality treatment at home, making it easy to enjoy professional-grade skincare without leaving the house. If you are looking for a high-quality, effective, and convenient way to treat your skin, look no further. These masks offer excellent hydration, brightening, and calming effects, making them a must-have in any skincare routine. Highly recommended!

I’ve been eyeballing these but was skeptical because for the price they seemed too good to be true, but they had so many good reviews I went for it and I’m glad I did. The winter is not been good to my skin so far and even with daily moisturizing I was getting a lot of dry flaky patches. They are hard to see in the pics but after one mask for 15 min the dryness was 100% gone and my skin felt really soft! I also think it got rid of some redness in my cheeks. It didn’t seem to do much for the acne blemishes I have right now, but they are advertised as being more moisturizing and restorative and since I have sensitive skin the fact that the mask didn’t make the breakout worse is still a huge win in my book. I plan to use these twice a week and will absolutely order more if they all work this well. Also, I don’t know if it’s the serum that’s on these or the material they are made of but this mask definitely stayed on my face better than some other sheets I have tried. I sat down but didn’t have to hold my head back to feel like it was secure whereas with other products I usually feel like I have to be lying down to keep it on.

It doesn’t fit my face. It’s an odd design and I I don’t feel comfortable wearing it. It covers like my eye like it gets close up to my eyelids and there’s this funky like nose. Just look at the picture, it’s weird what does the cut out hole in the nose part?? Is this a defect or is there a purpose? Your instructions and the pictures does not show it. And I can’t even return it because I threw away the box and the label. That’s my fault but to be fair I’ve never had this problem with mask. Disappointed.

I found that moisturizing masks were fun while working from home. Ingredients posted are for the charcoal mask. But the ingredients are pretty much the same across the set. I won't promise miracles or vast differences, but I used maybe once a month. I felt hydrated and smooth afterward. That's enough to pamper this work-from-home mom on a time budget!

avis.titre: Amazing! Great for sensitive dry skin. 😍
avis.texte: These masks are amazing! I have eczema and super sensitive dry skin. I don't use scented lotions for fear if I touch my face I will have an allergic reaction. I was afraid when I first used the mask because I was afraid I would have a reaction. I have tried several different masks so far and have had no allergic reaction to any of the masks I have tried. I took a picture before I started using the masks and I can definitely see a difference already. I don't use them everyday. Probably once or twice a week depending. My face feels so silky and smooth after. The only annoying thing is I have to constantly smooth it back on my face. It wants to fall off around the sides of my face and under my chin. But not a super big deal. Highly recommend and will definitely buy again.

Let me start with a very important comment: If you are ever, and I do me EVER, going to dye your hair, use a new lotion, try out a new shampoo, or give a face mask a whirl, you always need to test the product on a small part of your body. The back of your arm or wrist are usually go to spots for testing. If nothing happens after an hour, you are usually good to go. I didn't do that and it's either because I've done it too much to worry, so I'm either dumb, daring, or a dangerous mix of the two. By the way: I had no bad reactions to this face mask. ON WITH THE REVIEW! I tried it out and was floored with how hydrated my skin felt. I've only used it once and my roommate is as well. I'll update in a month with further results. ^_^ So far, I would recommend and I plan on buying more.

Great buy I've used a few of them and I really like them :) Ok here's my update after using this product for a while. My first tip is they are really cold room temperature. I like to soak the unopened package in warm water for a minute or so to warm the mask before putting it on. I feel like this opens your pores up and you absorbed the essence more. My next update is yes these are cheap for a reason. All these seem to do is moisturize and there nice and relaxing, but they really all seem the same. If you want a mask that is going to make a big difference in your skin try my new favorite mask tonymoly snail gel mask. Gel masks fit your face better and I feel they are better quality. I still don't say these are bad, but there are much better options out there.

After a year of using these masks, my aunt and colleagues have noticed the change and they asked me to buy them a pack too for them to try. My face glows everyday and acne doesn't show up unexpectedly anymore. This has got to be the cheapest sheet mask in the entire Milky Way Galaxy. The pack includes 16 sheets for less than $10.00!!!! Not to mention the different imperial ingredients!!! Aloe, Herb, Aqua, Charcoal, Pearl, Platinum, Snail, Hyaluronate, Cucumber, Green Tea, Vitamin C, and my personal faves Q10, Gold and Royal Jelly. All of them have collagen and act as an essence so double the winnings! I let the mask sit on my skin for 20-30 mins while doing whatever I have to do then wipe the mask’s residue on my knees, elbows, legs and arms or pretty much my whole body. Because why not?! The photo has only 1 sheet left so I need to buy another pack. Haha!

I have been using the Tony Molly brand for over a year yet decided based on the reviews and price to give the Dermal Korean masks an equal chance. I am in love! They feel amazing and the selection is increadable! I recieved the Aqua Collagen,Aloe,Syn-ake,Viatamin (C),Herb, White,Royal Jelly, Hyaluronate,Pearl,Charcoal, Q10,Platinum, Green Tea,Gold,Snail,and Cucumber masks in my order. I like that the masks are somewhat larger than the other brand and that you can get under the eye better with the folding potion on the mask aroung the eyes, verse regular cut outs with the other brand. There is plenty of serum left in the pouch to add to your face and or neck after you remove the mask when finished. I like using my masks at least three times a week so this will cover me for a month, for less than I pay for lipstick. I look forward to many many more nights of happy masking with Dermal Korean Collagen Essences Masks!

I absolutely love these face sheets. They are an incredible steal. Can't beat this price! The pack will last you a long time. I love all of the sheets for different reasons. Love that it comes in a variety pack to revitalize your skin in different ways depending on the sheet. My favorite is the Q10. I can feel it working after I take it off. I would advise everyone to read the instructions. Normally I would wash off my face after a face mask but with these sheets you should just simply dab off the excess. This way your skin will soak up the collagen and whatever added vitamins/ingredients are on that particular sheet. Leaves your skin looking radiant throughout the day-- love it! My only complaint would be these sheets are way too big for my face. If you have a small face then prepare to be folding the excess sheet under your chin and around your jaw line like me!

So it's winter here in Michigan, so my skin gets EXTREMELY DRY and I break out because of it. I've tried all sorts of oils, facial cleansers, scrubs, you name it, to get rid of my acne. I've recently got it bad on my chin and it's super embarrassing. So I decided to dry out these face masks. I was a bit skeptical at first because they're so cheap and you get 16 of them and I also didn't know the ingredients.. But, hey, gotta try things sometimes ya know? So I got them and immediately after using one, I saw results the next day. I've been using them every other day or every two days, and all that's left is scarring, no pimples, and my face is extra glowy. I love these and I would DEFINITELY buy again💙 REMEMBER. EVERYONE'S SKIN IS DIFFERENT. just because it worked for mine, does not mean it may work for yours. 😊

avis.titre: Relaxing, moisturizing and cool but sticky!
avis.texte: I tried the collagen essence mask and this had no scent. If you are tired and want to take nap. Better put this on because this is so cool, refreshing and relaxing. My skin is very dry and sensitive so i was concerned that i would have irritation. But i was amazed that there was no skin irritation. However, i did not like the sticky part of this mask. Or, may be since this is my first time using face mask sheet. Before putting on the mask, try allergy test with little serum of mask on your face.
i use these all the time they make my face feel more hydrated :). they don't break me out or cause any irritation so overall they do the job

avis.titre: Love them despite the weird scents
avis.texte: I love these face masks. They really work for me. I have sensitive skin and combo acne and loads of acne scars. I use them after I shower in the evening and right before I head to bed. I don’t wash the extra moisture from the mask off because it’s full of good stuff and it dries quickly. This is my second purchase of these masks and I’ve seen a slow but steady improvement in my skin’s quality. My only complaint is that the nose part is too small for me. I like that the scents are so subtle but water? Syn-ake? Pearl? White? Maybe the translation is off on a few of them.
Me gusta mucho el producto, estas mascarillas idea tan muy bien mi piel, cumple los requisitos para estar entre mis preferidas

My skin has been painfully dry this winter. Makeup has been drawing even more attention to it. I tried heavy cream moisturizers but they didn’t absorb and just left me greasy and dry (a sad combo). I’d gotten some of these masks in a subscription box and decided to give them a shot. I might look like I’m going to start yelling about putting the lotion in the basket but I don’t need the lotion anymore! My skin’s texture has improved and I can wear makeup again. I’ve been using these every few days. Yeah they’re silly looking but relaxing to use at night.
I bought these to go in goody bags, and they were a hit! It was neatly packed and looks good, with no damage. Items looked just like picture in the description.

avis.titre: Great Purchase for the price - WORTH IT!
avis.texte: I am a skin girl, I obsess over having a nice clear complexion yet also VERY sensitive skin anything makes me break out or have an allergic reaction. I purchase expense and budget friendly products and these are great for the price. I like to place them in the fridge for 10-20 mins if I feel puffy so it may reduce that inflammation. I struggle with combination skin and use 2- sheet masks per week and it has helped to even my skin out, also great to use prior to putting on make up to give you an extra glow. The whole pack can last up to 2 months so worth every single cent!

Wowww. This stuff is incredible. I'm going to be 50 in September of this year. I seriously wasn't expecting much from one face sheet, but I'll let you be the judge! I used the "Water" collagen mask. (It was the first one I grabbed, so went with it.) This pic was taken about 10 minutes ago, and the mask was applied about 5 hours ago. (I'm completely makeup free here.) My face is so soft and clean; not oily or dry- just right. It feels well-nourished. I'm an instant fan and will definitely be using these things for the rest of my life. Excellent product!

I have used these in the past and I love them. They hydrate the face and are great for self care days. They are slightly thicker than some other masks and have a LOT of serum. They stay moist on the face for a long time so you cam really relax with them. The extra serum is good for the neck and I even get some for my hands. I've tried many other brands but these are the best sheet masks for my skin.

Best sheet masks I have used. The base formula is the same, just the titled ingredient alters. The titled ingredient is the 3rd or 4th ingredient, and I really feel you get the benefits of that speciality ingredient as it is a strong component of the mask. I spend a great deal of time in hotel rooms and my skin was drying out horribly and reacting to the harsh detergents. Since I have been using these masks the redness and irritation is a thing of the past. I use them every other day when in hotels, and one weekly at home. I'm 39, and these have made my skin about a decade younger. Pic is 2 hours after using a mask, clearly no makeup. Give them a try!

I definitely say yes to this product it work great if done properly. Wash your face do toner, serum and slap this on! They are well moisturized, and actually tone, even out skin tone and brighten. You do have to use them maybe every 2-3 days to actually see a difference but I love this product especially for the price. I have oily, dry skin with persistent little bumps and these sooth the skin and soul. (Kinda) why not try it? Do it buy it I say!
This 16 pack of facial sheets will keep you relaxed is a great value and versatile with 16 different types, moisturizing, easy to use and remove, a great pick me up

These masks work wonderful!!! I was skeptical at first due to the low price - maybe I am just used to masks being so darn expensive but this was a great buy! Not only you are getting a satisfying amount of masks, they actually work. My skin did not break out and I was enjoying my own personal spa days at home easily with these. Will be purchasing more in the future!

avis.titre: Not too good for my skin
avis.texte: So I've just recently got into skin care routines and facemasks and this is actually the first brand that I've tried. So like other people are saying the masks are kind of big so they seem to not fit my face that well no matter how I position them so that was one issue. I did like how smooth my face was because of using them. However, my face did seem very oily after using them and you could feel how wet your face was and it took a while to dry. During the three week period I used them (using one once a week) I noticed that after each one my face seemed to be a little irritated. The third one I used is the worst one I've had so far (as seen in the pictures) . I used one on Tuesday and today my face is itchy, burning, red, irritated Etc. I'm kind of upset because I had high hopes for this set of face masks, but it looks like my skin is just not for them, so I'm going to have to find something else.

Uso las mascarillas una vez por semana, lavo previamente mi rostro con agua tibia, pongo la mascarilla por 15-20 min y luego aplico loción o en algunas ocaciones enjuago nuevamente con agua tibia. Deja mi piel extremadamente suave, humectada y con un aspecto más claro y brillante. El aroma es muy suave y las mascarilla se ajusta perfectamente al rostro, no gotea en exceso ni su consistencia es demasiado pegajosa. Totalmente la recomiendo para pieles sensibles .

avis.titre: Great if you don't mind being referred to as a serial killer.
avis.texte: Product is good. These are the first sheet masks I have ever used so I can't compare to others, but I enjoy using them. They smell nice, they are easy to use, and are soothing. My husband keeps asking me where the well is and has repeatedly referred to me as "buffalo bill" while I am wearing the masks. So there's that.

SPA DAY AT HOME I absolutely love sheet mask and one of my favorite brands is Dermal mask. The price was amazing you can beat it. I received 16 sheet mask ALL 16 different VERY EXCITED about that.
